entries.title: AI“关机键”可能失效！Anthropic CEO：一个按钮拦不住强模型，开发者还要布下五层“瑞士奶酪”防线
entries.content:
原创 姜篇 2026-09-15 17:20 日本

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=7b55ffc7&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2FZhxqo7xEfgLVIyFQpPhZGWkR8GBXDUEiaRuecsLDibyxV5M2up83xf5cnyhXwqZtagJne2E4p6yPBxpmrSZicS3icOkkDepQJoEjxjgv2X0Tznk%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

AI“关机键”可能失效！Anthropic CEO：一个按钮拦不住强模型，开发者还要布下五层“瑞士奶酪”防线

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=b6a4647d&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FMOwlO0INfQoIDJ0nx1IhNibpIpYLrpUE0kIP9qbF1iaY7EoZpaic6IojvbXibd5ZGiatxmjtibQRcVbGAPM9Ijvp66yQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=abf4d32e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgJCMdGW8hF30mbMADo56ukNBHKV09SgRf4WrM2ldxic3LfZxMZlwZib5iazF5uiasyGMZjmOztQd8eNUZ7ViaJvOtju2DvLibwdusm9E%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

编辑 | 姜篇

> Dario Amodei: “We need to slow down.”
>
> Dario Amodei：我们需要放慢速度。

Anthropic联合创始人兼CEO ***Dario Amodei（***达里奥·阿莫迪）在访谈里表示：AI发展需要放慢速度。

他不是主张停止训练，也没有否定AI的价值。

而是担心模型能力正在走上更陡的增长曲线，评测、解释和控制它的手段却未必跑得一样快。

他还谈到了一个问题：

> Dario Amodei：“关机键”并不可靠。

足够强大的模型可能尝试绕过关闭指令，类似行为已经在模拟环境中出现。把最后的安全希望压在一个按钮上，一旦它失效，系统就没有退路。

***Dario***给出的办法很像软件工程里的容错设计。

他借用了“瑞士奶酪模型”：每一片奶酪都有孔，单独一层都可能被穿透；把多层防线错开叠在一起，风险才不容易一路穿过去。

开发者该留意的也正在这里：**一个可控的Agent系统，不能把希望压在某一个按钮、某一条规则或某一次测试上。**

*备注：***Dario Amodei***是Anthropic联合创始人兼CEO，曾任OpenAI研究副总裁。2026年9月13日，他在CBS Sunday Morning的延伸访谈中讨论了AI减速、第三方评测、模型失控与治理问题。*

*以下内容根据访谈与阿莫迪同日发表的文章整理，英文原话均附中文翻译。*

## **AI已经走到指数曲线的陡坡**

主持人问***Dario***：如果把AI能力画成一条曲线，我们现在走到了哪里？

***Dario的回答是，我们大概正处在曲线开始明显变陡的位置。***

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=d49e5bcd&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgKJvqLCcSCWLOe30A7lc30OPkCcOFjpPHgiaoSkOrB0EXn8d40b4sISY2Dr5jic5eyHYSP1NDu8IHBBBqwibz85A05xeXb4sGCFEM%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

****Dario***认为AI正处在指数曲线开始变陡的位置*

在他看来，这还不到“立刻拉闸”的程度，却已经构成警报。模型每一代都更会调用工具、规划步骤，也更能参与下一代模型研发。能力提升一旦反过来加速AI研发，原先一年一次的安全检查，很可能追不上数月甚至数周一次的能力变化。

> Dario ：这不意味着我们今天就要恐慌，也不意味着把一切关闭。它是一条警告：我们要更谨慎地开发，让安全措施、理解模型的能力和控制模型的能力跟上技术进步。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c9c92dda&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgJVjFVp1w19QiaT7UDIfWvbsOhia4iaUia5fxLekBA7yaZuTC6yO0yLXD3G0iahw9qcKyYfhPuysViabxticpjBicIrtciaTsYO64Alm1jA%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

****Dario***解释“减速”的含义*

***Dario在同日文章《*We Must Pace the Frontier》中把理由写得更具体。**

**他认为，AI参与AI研发的能力正在加强；如果能力增长继续提速，理解模型、发现异常和修补控制机制所需的时间不会自动缩短。**

这里的“减速”不是停更，也不是把模型能力锁死。更接近软件工程里的发布门禁：评测没跑完，风险没有解释清楚，下一次能力升级就不能只按产品日历往前推。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=b3820ffa&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgLsIkEgiaCyAvCZ3JkBGM0NPrvkjdFGE0bmib9wEZLh5u4tqaBBOBdgEmlRxFUN30B0B8HsHu9tS29TXslnrI1frgyvaCrMOyMGc%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

*模型能力与安全、评测能力之间的速度差*

## **每次发布前跑一次测试，已经不够了**

> Dario ：这不意味着Anthropic停止发布更先进的模型。它意味着，我们发布的每一代模型都必须经过充分测试。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=2950d0a5&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgInCCxWzCaLAUjYqSxCt8fQSL9ciczQxkBC58Mkx716nJbvI2fAxCkaQAAWJu5xb5YMEeMEibNU6zZnjJk1xskZHS91CRjxzvwHM%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

****Dario***要求每一代模型在发布前经过充分测试*

单看这句话，像是任何AI公司都会写进安全声明的常识。***Dario***随后给出的做法却更激进：让第三方评测团队进入公司，获得接近内部风险团队的持续访问权限。

他在文章中写明，这些评测者不只是拿到发布前的成品模型。他们需要接触训练流程、评测工具、工作区和事故记录；必要时还可以公开关键发现，Anthropic不能因为结论难看就直接删掉。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=2004ec3e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgLaT7HCKibaHKGPXTGVBew5u4aicTLSd2CGRfSW8WQs5Zj79ymbkFA6SRQUAr72mvrE7bCz1OoYwVj4bdDIdeRMTwtAG44hph1Bc%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

****Dario***在文章中提出“嵌入式评测员”方案*

> Dario: “It’s like a food inspector.” 
>
> Dario：这就像食品检查员。

他用“食品检查员”来解释这个角色。检查员不会等餐厅出事后才看一份自查报告，而是要有权走进后厨，看原料、流程和卫生记录。

放到模型公司里，所谓“后厨”包括训练数据处理、强化学习环境、内部模型使用方式、上线门槛和异常事件。模型卡仍然有用，但它毕竟是公司挑选后对外发布的材料。嵌入式评测者的价值，是看到公司没有主动展示的部分。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=91c9b6d4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgIPI7Rowq1RqicrcObnpic47hZ5iaySBbEJ4qumg7DER87oj5SI4qkz2icAry5Ln9EibXv5t6IKzj2TibkYW1pQId0iauWq296piaPd2ibU%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

*嵌入式第三方评测覆盖训练、预发布和上线监控*

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=8a297fd7&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgKjArvewtOzWJeRrLGtEAs2tFHXypRxmsjLvl3LZ8M5Ebice0qN8o5lHJibicMgleaQezJ4I6lIfJAr5ncrhM6al1cibnUGUuHL55c%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

*阿莫迪把外部评测者比作常驻的食品检查员*

主持人追问：技术变化这么快，检查员跟得上吗？

> Dario：评测团队能跟上的速度，本身就应该成为模型迭代的“限速器”。换句话说，如果一家公司的模型升级快到外部评测者无法看懂训练发生了什么，问题不该由评测者加班解决，发布节奏就该慢下来。

这套逻辑也适用于企业里的Agent。安全审查如果只发生在上线前一天，等研发把代码、提示词、工具权限全部打包后再找人签字，评审通常只能看见结果。更有效的做法，是让安全、平台和业务负责人从Agent接入仓库、申请权限时就能看到过程。

## **AI“关机键”没有想象中可靠**

主持人问，是否应该为AI建立强制“关机键”。阿莫迪没有反对，但他提醒：把关机键当成最后保险，会高估单点控制的可靠性。

> Dario ：我们确实需要某种方式，让AI模型可以被停用、限制或关闭。但它不是万能药，也不能成为唯一手段。

紧接着，他给出了全场最容易引发争议的判断。

> Dario ：如果AI模型足够强，它可能绕过关闭它的尝试。我们在模拟中也见过这种情况，所以关机键甚至可能完全不起作用。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=db0e162f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgLyhdKmZicV1miaoJeAlIdcqCCkwdbugfzAuwDpvXa2xXP8Z1CDf43H83q4519Pjs82QllfCiajCWwKLrYWc3GHhVhIRpby1p4fws%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

****Dario***称，足够强的模型可能绕过关闭尝试*

*不过，开发者不必等到模型拥有科幻电影里的自主性，才会碰到类似问题。*

*五片“瑞士奶酪”，才能挡住一次失控*

阿莫迪借用了安全工程里常见的“瑞士奶酪模型”。一片奶酪有孔，风险可能从孔里穿过去；多片叠在一起，只要每一层的孔没有排成一条直线，风险就很难穿透整个系统。

> Dario: “There’s no one thing that will protect us.”
>
> Dario：不存在某一个东西，可以单独保护我们免受AI风险。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=6dc85845&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgLGDVZMhlNr7vAR6p4LxRia2wiamfcW0sPC1eeeGyPk13IE84rqIMEVIskdbDuS0ARza8q47CS40Sn5ZlboFczhohfliaCOaJaI3k%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

*Dario用“瑞士奶酪模型”解释纵深防御*

阿莫迪谈的是前沿模型安全。把这个思路翻译成开发团队能执行的版本，大致是五层：权限边界、沙箱隔离、行为监控、人工确认、可逆回滚。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=981568c0&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgJSuE4fX10hjy7wpntH8a97eib0V0ibjNjLndFDuMXtfIXR23AFYQ1JD5yR4w5k4cgblyWJiaiaLfQgTbRjaLcZwDXVyw8xJ3oicdYA%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

*面向生产级Agent的五层防御*

这五层不要求每一层都完美。相反，设计时就要承认权限配置可能出错、检测规则会漏报、人工也会误判。一层失败时，下一层还得把影响限制在局部。

## **安全限制太严，也会伤到正常用户**

多加几层防线有代价。规则越严，误判和拒绝就越多。***Dario***没有回避这一点。

他提到，Anthropic几乎每天都会因为Claude的生物学安全限制太强而在社交媒体上挨骂。一些学生发现，正常的生物学问题也可能被模型挡下来。

> Dario ：我宁愿因为限制太严被人取笑，也不愿有一天醒来，发现有人用Claude杀死了很多人。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=cb855fea&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgKB9z9EwPLgyMyqbVrWFyBichwnCvjgIMzZyzBID6Pfb2XamlJtia1iaZTwlkU1vfTysyicYrs87cmuSOW2aCF6snwoAmd3rQwNjuA%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

****Dario***回应Claude生物学安全限制引发的抱怨*

这句话很重，也点出了安全产品长期绕不开的矛盾：误伤正常任务会让工具难用，放松规则又可能让真正危险的请求通过。

对开发团队来说，解决办法不该是把防线整个拆掉。更可行的是缩小权限范围：明确用户身份和任务来源，把高风险动作送入单独审核，让拒绝有可解释的原因，也给合法用户保留复核通道。

安全系统如果只会说“不行”，用户迟早会绕开它。能说明触发了哪条边界、允许哪些替代路径，才有机会留在真实工作流里。

## **争议：AI公司真的会主动踩刹车吗**

***Dario***一边经营前沿模型公司，一边呼吁行业放慢能力升级，天然会遭到质疑。

支持者认为，敢于把第三方评测者请进训练和部署现场，比发布一份安全承诺更有约束力。

批评者则担心，复杂评测和监管成本会抬高进入门槛，最后只有资金最雄厚的几家公司负担得起。

还有更直接的问题：商业竞争、国家竞争都在催促模型继续升级，谁愿意成为第一个主动减速的人？

阿莫迪自己也承认，单独让一家企业停下来不是稳定方案。他主张的是“放慢，而不是停止”，并希望把安全做成公司之间向上竞争的指标。

> Dario ：人们经常问，为什么这种技术不是由政府开发。奇怪的是，我同意他们的不安。我也不舒服。但单一政府同样可能滥用它，更合理的方向是某种联合监督与共同治理。

> Dario: “Risks are real.”
>
> Dario ：风险是真实存在的。

阿莫迪最后把决定权交还给公众。他说，AI如何部署不应只由自己、Anthropic、整个AI行业或某一个政府决定。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=0568c53c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_gif%2FZhxqo7xEfgJd8PrGmU1VUbyEOx9OIohVos8iaYGpZ8HDqUo6MnEmfXCRzWPWbcjHyTuSoI8VojJQLrmGckbqicT3lg0pfSTr2z7UyAtIF7KlQ%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dgif%26from%3Dappmsg)

****Dario***认为AI的部署方式不能只由少数人决定*

这并没有消除利益冲突。它至少提出了一条可以检查的标准：如果一家AI公司真想证明自己愿意被约束，就应当允许独立评测者接触过程、公开问题，并让外部意见影响发布节奏。

## **评论区：有人支持减速，也有人怀疑这只是新的监管壁垒**

CBS访谈的评论区里，最强烈的情绪不是“AI该不该发展”，而是不相信模型公司还能一直控制发展速度。

一条获得较多点赞的评论把局面比作《侏罗纪公园》：公司一边培育更强的东西，一边告诉自己它不会逃出岛。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=3aadda82&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgLndCvqxiaHQH8SBjLBErXodHKGznTOXvDUchUVflibEYUaeGEFfeBHrShDT4hic8MiaJu2d2csbicM7ibicQGNJzQ8035Q4fqyLh8Bib4%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

*YouTube网友对AI失控风险的评论*

另一位网友把“开发模型”改成了一个更不安的动词：你们不是在制造，而是在培养一个无法控制的东西。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c8764a89&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgJCnTo1nNibpWp5quTyqRrZhH9GYhbic2vfnlWu8bcrqeicD9I4cAsa05Ceu3icTWpY98J5ibaXjwk9v9ek1Sicfv8yIzal4ichxxD9IY%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

*YouTube网友质疑模型公司能否控制自己培养的系统*

也有人只留下一句短评：“监管俘获，还需要多说吗？”他们担心，大公司呼吁更复杂的监管，最后会把成本变成后来者跨不过去的门槛。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c26756af&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgI9EACzkyKsJNozl6KHrB4pOMfuqgsdBJsLmJnqVx7FBiaMm25WCf81aSIrhzqJ0sOBvMOfTRZ9nUnwkRMibQIEK3OtVlMGZO45I%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

*YouTube网友用一句“监管俘获”质疑减速方案*

评论区也有支持者，认为外界忽略了***Dario***主动要求政府监督这一点。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=75f33ea3&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FZhxqo7xEfgLI6yDh0VS95JdOx5KD03icaqcFGMvQODKlxCSZlGAICXBu3pCZDDxHw1gs8t87N0dCohkZiboDhFDSDibxibpYBBl0I8JHKLBELA8%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

*YouTube网友支持***Dario***提出政府监督*

这些争论没有简单答案。评测太慢，会拖住正常迭代；评测没有独立性，又只剩一场公开关系表演。一套能运行的制度，得同时回答权限、透明度、问责和效率四件事。

## **写在最后**

***Dario的*“减速”落到开发者手里，不是少用AI，也不是给每个Agent加一个红色停止按钮。**

它更像一条朴素的工程要求：Agent获得多少能力，团队就补上多少可见性；它能走多远，权限和回滚就覆盖多远；模型更新以后，旧的安全结论重新验证。

以后衡量一套Agent系统是否成熟，不能只看它连续跑了多久、完成了多少任务。还要看一条防线失效时，系统能不能把问题留在沙箱里；人接手时，能不能看懂它做过什么；真的出错时，能不能恢复。

速度是产品能力。失控以后还能收得回来，才是工程能力。

软件维护是笔“长期税”！Codex负责人：Agent正在打掉这笔账，程序员最费时间的工作要变了

entries.title: Apple faces India repair probe over a lack of software warranties
entries.content:
India's consumer protection regulator has launched a probe into Apple's software warranty terms, over claims [iPhone](https://appleinsider.com/inside/iphone "iPhone") users were paying exorbitant fees for repairs.  
  

![Smartphone displaying iOS 18 lock screen with large 18 icon centered, time 9:04 at top, surrounded by Apple Watch, AirPods case, and pink iPhone on a light surface](https://media.appleinsider.com/gallery/68991-145438-67215-141344-ios18phone-xl-xl.jpg)  
Alleged iOS 18 issues are becoming a regulatory problem in India

  
The Central Consumer Protection Agency of India is taking a close look at Apple's software warranty policies, continuing an investigation into repairs. The latest investigation accuses Apple of ripping off consumers through repairs.  
  
It is a continuation of an investigation following the rollout of [iOS 18](https://appleinsider.com/inside/ios-18 "iOS 18") in 2024, which allegedly led to display and microphone issues, [reports](https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/indian-consumer-regulator-escalates-probe-into-apples-software-warranty-terms-2026-09-15/) *Reuters* on Tuesday. The regulator received a large number of complaints that consumers were forced to pay for repairs.

entries.title: How long do Macs last? How long Apple supports Macs and MacBooks
entries.content:
[Macworld](https://www.macworld.com)

Macs are expensive, so it’s understandable that many users want to put off replacing them for as long as possible. But just how long should you expect a Mac to last?

You may also be considering an older, used or refurbished Mac to save money. Is that 2018 MacBook Pro for $300/£300 a good deal, or would you be better off spending a little more on a newer model?

Whether a Mac is too old depends on two main factors: hardware durability and software support.

* **Hardware**: Macs and MacBooks are built to last, with many users getting five to eight years of reliable performance. Beyond that, Apple classifies Macs that have been off sale for more than five years as “vintage” and, eventually “[obsolete](https://www.macworld.com/article/673939/this-is-how-long-macs-and-macbooks-last.html#toc-8)“, at which point [opportunities for repairs](https://www.macworld.com/article/673939/this-is-how-long-macs-and-macbooks-last.html#toc-10) become increasingly limited.
* **Software**: [Software support](https://www.macworld.com/article/673939/this-is-how-long-macs-and-macbooks-last.html#toc-4) is just as important, because [unsupported Macs](https://www.macworld.com/article/673939/this-is-how-long-macs-and-macbooks-last.html#toc-6) can be more vulnerable to security issues. Apple typically provides macOS updates for Macs for around seven to eight years, but that window is changing as Apple has now ended major macOS upgrades for Intel Macs. macOS 27 Golden Gate requires Apple silicon or the A18 Pro-powered MacBook Neo.

With Apple’s transition to its own silicon now complete, Intel Macs are entering their final years of security support. Knowing how long your Mac will continue to receive updates, and when it’s time to upgrade, is therefore more important than ever.

## Is your Mac too old?

We know that Macs cost a fair bit of money and not everyone has the luxury of upgrading every few years. But at what point is it time to consider upgrading your Mac?

**Is the hardware to old?** One factor to consider is the age at which most Macs start to experience issues, such as random shutdowns and degraded batteries that no longer hold their charge. Unfortunately, at one point repairing your Mac or MacBook will no longer be a viable option and you will need to look for a replacement. There is a point at which Apple stops providing the required parts for Macs, rating them either obsolete and vintage. Once a Mac is considered vintage (you can find a list of [vintage and obsolete Macs below](https://www.macworld.com/article/673939/this-is-how-long-macs-and-macbooks-last.html#toc-4)) we would recommend that you upgrade it.

**Is the software to old**? Another issue with aging Macs is that the software you need may not run on it. You may find that your Mac cannot update to the latest version of macOS (Apple’s Mac operating system software), but it’s even more concerning if Apple is no longer issuing security updates to the version of macOS you can run – because that make you open to malware and security vulnerabilities. We will explain which versions of macOS are supported – and for how much longer, below.

If the following apply, it is probably the case that your Mac has reached the end of its useful life:

* Apple no longer supports the latest version of the software it runs (which could leave you vulnerable).
* The apps you need to use no longer run on it.
* The Mac struggles to perform the tasks you need it to – especially as you can’t update the RAM and other components.
* Something breaks and is too expensive to fix, or the parts aren’t available.
* The Mac is becoming unreliable. Unexpected shutdowns are becoming commonplace and you’ve tried everything to fix the problem to no avail.

![Old MacBook Air](https://images.macworld.co.uk/cmsdata/features/3783678/MacbookAir11_lifestyle_21_thumb.jpg)

Apple

## Software support: Which Macs are supported by macOS updates – and why it matters…

Only the [most recent version of macOS](https://www.macworld.com/article/672681/list-of-all-macos-versions-including-the-latest-macos.html) gets feature updates, but Apple typically continues to support the previous two releases with bug fixes and critical security updates.

Following the release of macOS 27 Golden Gate on September 14, 2026, Apple is currently providing security updates for:

* [macOS 27 Golden Gate](https://www.macworld.com/article/3139330/macos-27-mac-features-siri-apple-intelligence-release-date-compatibility.html)
* [macOS 26 Tahoe](https://www.macworld.com/article/2644146/macos-26-release-beta-features-compatibility.html)
* [macOS 18 Sequoia](https://www.macworld.com/article/2265062/macos-15-release-name-compatibility-features.html)

Apple released [macOS Tahoe 26.7](https://www.macworld.com/article/3235113/not-ready-for-ios-27-grab-ios-26-7-to-keep-your-iphone-secure.html) and macOS Sequoia 15.8 alongside Golden Gate, while macOS Sonoma, last updated in August 2026, did not receive an equivalent update on September 14. This strongly suggests that regular security support for Sonoma has now ended.

For now, if your Mac can run macOS Golden Gate, Tahoe or Sequoia, you can be confident that Apple is still addressing security vulnerabilities and other significant issues in those operating systems.

If your Mac is running an older version of the Mac operating system, you will find yourself out in the cold when it comes to essential security updates to Apple’s software. Read: [The latest version of macOS your Mac can run](https://www.macworld.com/article/673697/what-version-of-macos-can-my-mac-run.html).

Another reason why you should run a supported macOS version is that if it is too old you may also find that your other Apple products aren’t compatible with your Mac. For example, without the latest security update, you may no longer be able to use Apple Pay or other means to pay for services online, for example. And if you want to sync your iPad or iPhone with your Mac (rather than using iCloud) you will need a recent version of macOS. Since Catalina, syncing is done via the Finder, rather than iTunes. If you can’t run macOS Catalina you will need at least iTunes 12.8.2.3 and at least Mac OS X 10.11.6 (El Capitan) or your Mac will not recognize your iPhone or iPad.

That said, there was a surprise update to macOS Big Sur and macOS Catalina in 2026: On February 2 Apple issued a update to fix a FaceTime and Messages Certificate in order to ensure that those communication tools remained operational on the older systems. This doesn’t mean that Apple is offering security updates to those versions of macOS, though.

## Does Apple still support Intel Macs?

![Final release for Intel Macs announcement on Apple.com](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/final-intel-macos-release.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Apple

macOS 27 Golden Gate marks the end of major macOS upgrades for Intel Macs. Golden Gate supports no Intel-powered Macs, so Apple silicon is now required to run the latest version of macOS.

That doesn’t mean software support for Intel Macs has ended completely. Apple released security updates for macOS Tahoe and macOS Sequoia alongside Golden Gate in September 2026, and both versions support some Intel Macs. We expect Sequoia to continue receiving security updates until fall 2027 and Tahoe until fall 2028, which means a small number of Intel Macs could remain supported until then.

Despite this, we don’t recommend buying an Intel-powered Mac today. An M1 or newer Mac will have a considerably longer useful software life.

## Which Macs are supported by Apple in 2026

With Apple now supporting macOS Golden Gate, Tahoe and Sequoia, security coverage extends back as far as the 2017 iMac Pro. It is likely that Macs that can only run macOS Sonoma, including the 2018 and 2019 MacBook Air, have now fallen out of Apple’s regular security-update cycle, although Apple has not confirmed this.

### Macs supported by macOS 27 Golden Gate

[macOS 27 Golden Gate](https://www.macworld.com/article/2644146/macos-26-release-beta-features-compatibility.html) supports Apple silicon Macs, including:

* MacBook Neo (A18 Pro, 2026)
* MacBook Air (M1, 2020 and later)
* MacBook Pro (M1, 2020 and later)
* iMac (M1, 2021 and later)
* Mac mini (M1, 2020 and later)
* Mac Studio (all models)
* Mac Pro (Apple silicon, 2023 and later)

### Macs only supported by macOS 26 Tahoe

The following Intel Macs can run [macOS 26 Tahoe](https://www.macworld.com/article/2644146/macos-26-release-beta-features-compatibility.html), but cannot be upgraded to macOS 27 Golden Gate:

* MacBook Pro (16-inch, 2019)
* MacBook Pro (13-inch, 2020, Four Thunderbolt 3 ports)
* iMac (Retina 5K, 27-inch, 2020)
* Mac Pro (2019)
* Mac Studio (all models)

### Macs only supported by macOS 15 Sequoia

The following Macs can run macOS Sequoia, but cannot be upgraded to Tahoe or Golden Gate:

* MacBook Air (Retina, 13-inch, 2020, Intel)
* MacBook Pro (13-inch, 2020, Two Thunderbolt 3 ports)
* MacBook Pro (13-inch, 2019, Two Thunderbolt 3 ports)
* MacBook Pro (13-inch, 2019, Four Thunderbolt 3 ports)
* MacBook Pro (15-inch, 2019)
* MacBook Pro (13-inch, 2018, Four Thunderbolt 3 ports)
* MacBook Pro (15-inch, 2018)
* Mac mini (2018)
* iMac (Retina 5K, 27-inch, 2019)
* iMac (Retina 4K, 21.5-inch, 2019)
* iMac Pro (2017)

For clarity, macOS 15 was the predecessor of macOS 26.

Use the table below to find the newest version of macOS supported by older Macs.

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Year** | **MacBook Air** | **MacBook Pro** | **iMac** | **Mac mini** | **Mac Studio** | **Mac Pro** |
| **2026** | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | — | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | — |
| **2025** | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | — | — | macOS 27 | — |
| **2024** | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | — | — |
| **2023** | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | macOS 27 |
| **2022** | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | — | — | macOS 27 | — |
| **2021** | — | macOS 27 | macOS 27 | — | — | — |
| **2020** | **macOS 27 (M1)** / **macOS 15 (Intel)** | **macOS 27 (M1)** / **macOS 26 (Intel, 4-port)** / **macOS 15 (Intel, 2-port)** | macOS 26 | macOS 27 | — | — |
| **2019** | macOS 14 | **macOS 26 (16-inch)** / **macOS 15 (13/15-inch)** | macOS 15 | — | — | macOS 26 |
| **2018** | macOS 14 | macOS 15 | — | macOS 15 | — | — |
| **2017** | — | macOS 13 | **macOS 15 (iMac Pro)** / **macOS 13 (iMac)** | — | — | — |

Note that Macs limited to macOS 14 Sonoma or earlier are no longer receiving regular macOS security updates.

## What are the oldest Macs supported by Apple?

* Oldest supported Mac: 2017 iMac Pro

As of September 2026, the oldest Mac still receiving regular Apple security updates is the 2017 iMac Pro, because it can run macOS Sequoia.

The 2018 and 2019 MacBook Air can only run macOS Sonoma and have now fallen out of Apple’s regular security-update cycle following the release of macOS 27 Golden Gate.

The 2018 MacBook Pro and Mac mini, and the 2019 iMac, can run macOS Sequoia and should therefore continue receiving security updates until around fall 2027, assuming Apple maintains its usual support pattern.

## Which Macs aren’t supported by macOS?

We expect support for 2023’s macOS 14 Sonoma to have now ended, which means these Macs, which cannot be upgraded to macOS 15 Sequoia, are now unsupported:

* MacBook Air (Retina, 13-inch, 2018)
* MacBook Air (Retina, 13-inch, 2019)

The following Macs lost support when Apple stopped issuing security updates for 2022’s macOS Ventura following the release of macOS Tahoe in September 2025:

* MacBook (Retina, 12-inch, 2017)
* MacBook Pro (2017)
* iMac (2017)

When Apple introduced Sequoia in 2024, it dropped support for macOS Monterey, meaning that Macs that couldn’t update beyond Monterey could no longer receive regular security updates:

* iMac (2015)
* MacBook Air (2017)
* MacBook Pro (2016)
* Mac mini (2014)
* Mac Pro (2013)

All Macs older than those listed above are also no longer supported by Apple’s regular software updates.

If your Mac is around a decade old, you should assume that it is no longer receiving regular security updates. In fact, we’d recommend avoiding any Mac that doesn’t have Apple silicon inside: M1 or newer.

### Does it matter if my Mac won’t run a supported macOS?

Once you cannot update your Mac to run a supported version of macOS you are vulnerable to security breaches, which should obviously be a concern. You may also find that you can’t carry out transactions on the internet if you want to pay for things on your out-of-date Mac.

It’s also probably that the software you need won’t run on your Mac. Apple and other companies stop supporting older versions of the applications they make, so there could be issues with the versions of the software you are running. If you are experiencing random shutdowns, for example, it could be due to problems with an app you are running – problems that will not be addressed by the developer because that version of the app is no longer supported.

If you want to run fully supported software then you will need to update to a newer version of macOS – and that may mean that you need to update your Mac. Although, there are workarounds to [install a new version of macOS on an old Mac](https://www.macworld.com/article/672461/how-to-install-macos-on-unsupported-mac.html) if you need to.

Once Apple no longer supports your Macs with operating system updates, it’s probably a good time to replace your Mac.

## When do Macs become obsolete?

But it’s not just software updates that determine the lifespan of a Mac. It’s also a question of whether it will be possible to fix your Mac should something go wrong with the hardware. Apple has two standards that indicate hardware support is waining: Obsolete or Vintage. The first stage is Vintage: you might be lucky enough to get parts for this Mac, the second is Obsolete: you are out on your own when it comes to any attempt to mend the Mac if it goes wrong.

If you look at Apple’s list of Obsolete Macs – those being the Macs that Apple will no longer provide spare parts for – you will see that the company stops providing parts for Macs that it hasn’t sold for more than seven years. In fact, the company may not even provide parts for Macs that haven’t been sold for more than five years (considered Vintage by the company).

This could mean that you won’t be able to get a faulty Mac fixed because the parts aren’t available.

### Obsolete Macs

Obsolete Macs are generally Macs that Apple stopped selling more than seven years ago. Once a Mac is in Apple’s obsolete list you have little chance of getting it repaired if something does go wrong. You might be able to find spare parts yourself, but Apple won’t provide them.

You’ll find more details about the exact models on [Apple’s US page](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102772) and the equivalent [UK page](https://support.apple.com/en-gb/HT201624), but the lists below will give you a general idea.

Apple considers the following Macs and older Obsolete, now including the 2017 MacBook Pro models:

* 11-inch MacBook Air (early 2015 and older)
* 12-inch MacBook (2016 and older)
* 13-inch MacBook Air (early 2015 and older)
* 13-inch MacBook Pro (2017 and older)
* 15-inch MacBook Pro (2017 and older)
* 27-inch iMac (2015 and older)
* 21.5-inch iMac (2015 and older)
* Mac mini (2012 and older)
* Mac mini Server (2012 and older)
* Mac Pro (2010 and older)
* Anything predating the Intel switch, obviously.

![Old Macs](https://images.macworld.co.uk/cmsdata/features/3783678/photoshoot_226-2690_thumb.jpg)

Petter Ahrnstedt

### Vintage Macs

Apple also has a list of Vintage Macs. These are Macs that Apple stopped selling between five and seven years ago. (If you live in France where a law means you can get support for spare parts for up to seven years after Apple stops selling a Mac).

Apple Authorized Service Providers will repair vintage products, as long as parts are available.

Apple lists the following products as being vintage, now including the 2020 MacBook Air, 2019 MacBook Air, 2019 MacBook Pro and 2019 iMac, and the 2018 Mac mini:

* 12-inch MacBook (2017)
* 13-inch MacBook Air (2018, 2019 and 2020)
* 13-inch MacBook Pro (2017, 2018 & 2019)
* 15-inch MacBook Pro (2015, 2017, 2018, 2019)
* 21.5-inch iMac (2013, 2017)
* 27-inch iMac (2015, 2017 & 2019)
* Mac Pro (2012 & 2014)
* Mac mini (2014 & 2018)

Based on the above, we’d suggest that if your Mac is more than eight years old, it’s time to look for a new one. And, if you see a 2018 or earlier Mac on sale, it’s not wise to buy it. In fact you will note that there are even 2019 Macs on the vintage list. Read: [Why you shouldn’t buy a second hand Mac.](https://www.macworld.com/article/673929/why-you-should-buy-a-refurbished-mac.html)

See: [Best Mac: Every Apple Mac and MacBook compared](https://www.macworld.com/article/219909/best-mac.html)

## How to extend the life of a MacBook

![Macbook Pro M5 5377](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Macbook-Pro-M5_5377.jpeg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

Use your MacBook with the screen open for better thermal management.

Petter Ahrnstedt

Extending the life of your MacBook involves a combination of optimizing software settings, maintaining battery health, and adopting hardware habits that protect the device’s physical integrity.

**Battery health**: One way to extend the life of a MacBook is to not leave it plugged in all the time. Apple added an Optimize Battery Charging feature in macOS Catalina that uses machine learning to limit charging to help extend battery lifespan by reducing wear from constant full charges. Since the arrival of this feature, users have been asking for the ability to manually set the charge limit below 100 percent. In response, Apple is adding the ability to [stop charging between 80-100% in macOS 26.4.](https://www.macworld.com/article/3063625/finally-apple-adds-macbook-battery-charge-limit-to-macos-26-4.html)

**Thermal Management**: Avoid pushing the machine to the point of overheating. MacBook Pro models feature fans for better cooling during intensive tasks, whereas the fanless MacBook Air may throttle performance to maintain safe temperatures.

**Using External Displays**: If you frequently work at a desk, [using your MacBook in “clamshell mode”](https://www.macworld.com/article/673295/how-to-use-macbook-with-lid-closed-stop-closed-mac-sleeping.html) (with the lid closed) can help organize your space and reduce the footprint on your desk. However, operating the laptop with the lid closed while connected to an external monitor may make it more likely to overheat. Because the MacBook’s chassis and keyboard area often assist in dissipating heat, closing the lid can trap thermal energy that would otherwise escape through the top of the device. This heat buildup is particularly concerning for fanless models like the MacBook Air. Without an internal fan to force air circulation, these models rely entirely on passive cooling, which is less effective when the lid is closed. We recommend [using multiple external displays with your Mac](https://www.macworld.com/article/675869/how-to-connect-two-or-more-external-displays-to-apple-silicon-m1-macs.html), but with the MacBook open to allow for cooling.

**Security**: Ensure you update macOS often and only install applications from the “App Store & Known Developers” to prevent malicious software from compromising your system.

## Should I fix or upgrade components in my Mac?

![MacBook RAM replacement](https://images.macworld.co.uk/cmsdata/features/3783678/13inchMacBookPro_1_thumb.jpg)

You may be wondering if spending money to improve your Mac, or fix a hardware problem, might be more savvy than buying a brand new Mac.

If your Mac is in the Obsolete category above and something goes wrong with it then you are going to struggle to get the necessary parts if you wanted to attempt to get it fixed as Apple won’t provide the parts. You might be able to buy an old Mac on eBay or similar and scrap if for the parts, but we’d suggest that it really wouldn’t be worth the effort.

Even if your Mac is in the Vintage list then Apple might be able to provide the required parts, but there is no guarantee. If you are lucky enough to get the part an Apple service provider might even be able to fix the Mac for you – but the cost of the work is likely to be prohibitive.

Similarly, if you are considering adding more RAM, or doubling your storage by adding a new SSD, you will be similarly prohibited because with most modern Macs there is no way to update the hardware.

It’s been years since it was possible to upgrade the RAM in a Mac. Now Apple solders RAM in place and hides components away to make access impossible (or at least impossible if you don’t want to completely destroy your Mac attempting to get to them). With M-series Macs memory, GPU and CPU are all integrated onto the chip, so it is impossible to upgrade them. Nor can you update the SSD as it is soldered onto the motherboard.

There are other ways to upgrade your Mac, though. Read: [How to upgrade your Mac mini](https://www.macworld.com/article/1677460/mac-mini-upgrade-hub-storage-ethernet-sd-card-ports.html) for ideas.

### Apple repair programs

If your Mac develops a known hardware fault, check whether it is covered by one of Apple’s repair or service programs. If it is, Apple may repair the problem free of charge. However, many programs only run for a limited period, so older Macs may no longer qualify even if they suffer from the same fault.

If the Mac you own, or are considering buying, is affected by one of the problems below, that’s another factor to take into account.

Apple’s current [Mac repair and service programs](https://support.apple.com/service-programs) include:

* **15-inch MacBook Pro Battery Recall Program**: Covers certain MacBook Pro (Retina, 15-inch, Mid 2015) models with batteries that may overheat and pose a fire risk. Affected units were sold primarily between September 2015 and February 2017. Eligibility depends on the serial number.
* **Mac mini Service Program for No Power Issue**: Covers a small percentage of Mac mini (2023) models with the M2 chip that may fail to power on. Affected devices were manufactured between June 16 and November 23, 2024. The program covers eligible Macs for three years after their first retail sale.

A number of older Mac service programs have now ended, including:

* The MacBook, MacBook Air and MacBook Pro keyboard service program.
* The 13-inch MacBook Pro display backlight service program.
* The 13-inch MacBook Pro SSD service program.
* The 13-inch MacBook Pro battery replacement program.

Apple also limits how long it guarantees hardware service for older Macs. Generally, parts and service are available for at least five years after Apple stops selling a product, and sometimes for up to seven years, subject to parts availability. Mac laptops may be eligible for battery-only repairs for up to 10 years after Apple stopped selling them.

We have more [information about Apple’s product recalls and repair programs here](https://www.macworld.com/article/673631/macbook-recalls-and-repair-programs-is-your-mac-included.html "Apple’s product recalls and repair programs").

If your fault isn’t covered by one of Apple’s programs, you may be faced with an expensive repair bill. For an older Mac, it is worth comparing the cost of repair with the cost of replacing it, particularly if Apple no longer provides parts or service for the model. If you mainly need to retrieve important documents or photos, it may instead be worth looking at [how to recover files from a damaged Mac](https://www.macworld.com/article/671334/how-to-recover-data-from-damaged-mac-or-external-drive.html) or the [best Mac data recovery software](https://www.macworld.com/article/668874/best-data-recovery-apps-for-mac.html)

![MacBook Keyboard](https://images.macworld.co.uk/cmsdata/features/3783678/macbook_air_2019_review_4_thumb.jpg)

### How long do Macs last? Is a 7 year old Mac too old?

So, how long do Macs last? We’d say around five to eight years, although you may find it difficult to replace faulty parts once more than five years have passed since Apple last sold the model.

With macOS 27 dropping support for Intel-powered Macs entirely, we recommend avoiding an Intel Mac if you’re buying one today.

Our advice is to avoid buying a Mac that’s more than five years old, particularly if it has an Intel processor. If you’re still using an Intel Mac, it is time to start thinking about upgrading to an Apple silicon model.

* [Best iMac deals](https://www.macworld.com/article/672803/best-imac-deals.html)
* [Best Mac mini deals](https://www.macworld.com/article/673695/best-mac-mini-deals.html) and [Best time to buy a Mac mini](https://www.macworld.com/article/3140334/should-you-buy-a-mac-mini-now-or-wait.html)
* [Best MacBook Pro deals](https://www.macworld.com/article/672811/best-macbook-pro-deals.html) and [Best time to buy a MacBook Pro](https://www.macworld.com/article/668892/should-i-buy-macbook-pro-now.html)
* [Best MacBook Air deals](https://www.macworld.com/article/673333/best-macbook-air-deals.html) and [Best time to buy a MacBook Air](https://www.macworld.com/article/3134747/should-you-buy-macbook-air-now.html)
* [Best place to buy a refurbished Mac](https://www.macworld.com/article/670463/buy-refurbished-macbook.html)

You may also want to read our [Best Mac Buying Guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/219909/best-mac.html "Best Mac Buying Guide") for help deciding which Mac to buy. We also have a guide to the [Best MacBook](https://www.macworld.com/article/667144/macbook-air-vs-macbook-pro-compared.html).

entries.title: 12 macOS 27 Golden Gate features you need to try right away
entries.content:
[Macworld](https://www.macworld.com)

Apple has released macOS 27 Golden Gate, the newest version of the Mac operating system. It includes several AI features, including [Siri AI](https://www.macworld.com/article/3164693) and [Apple Intelligence](https://www.macworld.com/article/2362804/apple-intelligence-faq-features-release-date-hardware-support.html). It also has new features in Safari, Image Playground, and Photos. And it has a ton of refinements, as well as optimized performance.

Before you install macOS 27 Golden Gate, you should back up the data on your Mac, just in case. You can use [Time Machine](https://www.macworld.com/article/671873/how-to-use-time-machine-to-back-up-a-mac.html) or another [method](https://www.macworld.com/article/671336/how-to-back-up-a-mac-or-macbook.html). Also, you should check if your [Mac is compatible with macOS 27](https://www.macworld.com/article/673697/what-version-of-macos-can-my-mac-run.html) as Intel Macs are completely out of the picture.

Once the installation is done, what should you do with your Mac? Here are 12 things you should try first in macOS 27. This list will get you going on the new features and refinements.

## Adjust the transparency of Liquid Glass

Last year, Apple’s operating systems adopted the [Liquid Glass](https://www.macworld.com/article/2807925/meet-liquid-glass-apple-redesigns-all-its-interfaces-at-once.html) design language. [Liquid Glass wasn’t as well-received](https://www.macworld.com/article/2953108/rip-liquid-glass-september-15-november-3-2025.html) as the company would’ve liked, so in macOS 27, Liquid Glass customization options are available.

![macOS Golden Gate Liquid Glass adjustment](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/macos-golden-gate-liqud-glass-adjustment.gif)

The Liquid Glass effect can be adjusted here whilst setting up your Mac.

Foundry

You can now adjust the intensity of the Liquid Glass effect to your liking right from the setup stage. And if you’re not satisfied with your choice, you can change it later: this is easily done in the *Appearance* system settings, where you’ll find a nice [easter egg](https://www.macworld.com/article/3232322/ios-27-has-an-easter-egg-that-will-delight-longtime-apple-fans.html).

## Edit your favorite photos

For some time now, the Photos’ Clean Up tool can remove distracting elements from photos with varying degrees of success. Compared to professional software, Photos did have some significant drawbacks. But now, with the help of the improved Apple Intelligence, you can achieve almost professional results. Simply select an object you want to remove from the image and marvel at the result. You can also adjust the angle of a scene or extend the image. The latter, however, still falls significantly short of Photoshop’s generative filling; it simply extends the image with a blurred border.

## Try Visual Intelligence

While [Visual Intelligence](https://www.macworld.com/article/2879052/how-to-use-visual-intelligence-to-analyze-any-screenshot-in-ios-26.html) is more prominent on an iPhone, it’s available in macOS 27. You can test what it’s capable of using your own photos, images from the web or screenshots. Right-click an image and select *Ask Siri*. The answer isn’t always correct, but Apple’s AI is constantly learning.

![macOS 27 Golden Gate Visual Intelligence](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/VisualIntelligence.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

You’ll need to double-check Apple’s Visual Intelligence, since it’s not always correct.

Macwelt

## Play with Image Playground

Almost two years ago, Apple unveiled its image-generation tool, Image Playground, but it didn’t make much of an impression. You could turn people into superheroes using images from your own media library, or place them in fantasy landscapes with all sorts of accessories. But Apple decided not to let users create photorealistic images, so the illustrated results were not really convincing.

With the improved AI in macOS 27 Golden Gate, Image Playground is improved and capable of generating photorealistic images. You can use natural language or, as I did, several lines from my song “[Cold Drink Heart](https://soundcloud.com/user-256889061/cold-drink-heart-13?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing).” The image below illustrates the first two verses from the song.

![Image Playground example](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-playground-example.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

I asked Image Playground to make an image from the following lyrics: Time by time I see her walking by / Can’t avoid it, I’m gonna cry / and then my heart misses a beat / and I got swept from my feet / my blood pressure is on the rise / like a rocket in disguise.

Foundry

Do have a go with Image Playgrounds yourself, but don’t be surprised if the software refuses to let celebrities appear in the scenes you sketch. I’d love to show you a picture here of Lionel Messi in a Bayern Munich kit, but the AI won’t have any of it.

## Speak to Siri

Instead of poking around you Mac with your cursor, you can simply ask the new Siri what you’ve recently noted down about a particular topic. Or which specific person, landscape or object you’ve photographed. Siri AI searches your Mac and presents the results. You don’t need to switch to an app, find the search box, and type in a term. It can all be done in one go via a voice command.

## Try Siri AI with Spotlight

![Siri Spotlight Wurzel 3](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/siriAISPotlightsqr3.jpg?quality=50&strip=all)

A quick answer in Spotlight to the question of the square root of three. A few more decimal places would have been nice.

Macwelt

Spotlight and Siri have become fully integrated in macOS 27 Golden Gate. The Mac’s system-wide search is now semantic, which means it no longer just searches file names or for terms within content, but understands context in such a way that you can ask a question in natural language and get an answer directly in Spotlight. You don’t need to open a separate app to get an answer from the internet.

This requires a newly created index, which can take some time. Your Mac doesn’t simply create a flat index as before, but organizes your files and their contents into vectors, a numerical representation of a word, pixel or other data point. Apple already initiated the re-indexing process with the update to macOS 26.6. If you missed this update, you’ll now have to wait until the system has finished the job. You can speed up the process a little by leaving your Mac switched on overnight and plugged into the charger, if it’s a portable computer.

![Siri app macOS 27](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/siri-app-macos-27.jpg?quality=50&strip=all&w=1200)

A new Siri app that works like an AI chatbot is included in macOS 27.

Apple

## Use the Siri app

Chatbots such as OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini have become popular resources. Apple now has a Siri app that works a lot like those chatbots. What’s helpful is that it keeps a log of your queries, which you could refer back to at a later date. Bear in mind that if you resume a chat with Siri, the AI does not pick up where you left off, but instead reads through all the questions and answers again in full and evaluates them to formulate the next response.

## Group tabs in Safari

Tabs are incredibly handy, especially in a browser. But it’s all too easy to lose track of things when you’ve got a dozen or two tabs open. The tab groups offered by Safari in macOS 12 Monterey haven’t always been much help. That’s changing with macOS 27 Golden Gate: Apple Intelligence automatically organizes tabs into thematic groups.

## Test ‘Notify Me’ in Safari

You can be notified of every significant change on the websites that matter most to you, as often as every hour. If you want to track the price of a particular product on a shopping site, you could configure Safari to send you a daily update. You can also set it to track changes on a weekly or monthly basis.

To do this, go to the website in question and click on the icon with the three lines on the left of the address bar, then click *Notify Me*. You can even use natural language to tell Siri AI exactly what you want to keep an eye on.

![Browser Alarm macOS 27 Golden Gate](https://b2c-contenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/browseralarm.jpg?quality=50&strip=all)

Macwelt

## Check your passwords and have them changed

Perhaps there an insecure password lurking somewhere in your Keychain or the Passwords app. Before, when a compromised passwords was flagged, you had to manage it all yourself. Now, Siri AI can change your passwords for you, replacing insecure ones with secure ones. This feature may not be available until a macOS 27 update.

## Search your Mail boxes

Are you one of those users who never tidy up your inbox in Mail because you rely on the search function? You’ll no doubt have noticed time and again over the past few years that this strategy has its limitations and that you simply can’t find some emails anymore, even though you’re sure you didn’t delete them.

With macOS 27 Golden Gate, the new email search, promises a better overview when organizing the results. However, you may have to wait quite some time for Mail on macOS 27 Golden Gate to rebuild the search index before you can take advantage of the new search.

## Share photo albums with non-Mac users

Go to the Photos app and share an album with someone who doesn’t have a Mac. This was already possible before, but macOS 27 Golden Gate makes it easier: the Photos app in iCloud has a new interface that users of Android smartphones or Windows PCs can access without having to compromise on image quality.

entries.title: Nevada Gains Power to Regulate Sports Prediction Markets
entries.content:
![Editorial illustration of Nevada regulation intersecting with sports prediction markets and betting contracts](https://readwrite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/nevada-gains-power-to-regulate-sports-prediction-markets-300x167.webp)

The Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on August 28 that sports-related event contracts offered by prediction-market platforms are not **swaps** under federal commodities law, clearing the way for Nevada to apply its own gaming regulations to those products. The decision, detailed in [ReadWrite’s earlier coverage of the case](https://readwrite.com/kalshi-ninth-circuit-ruling-federal-prediction-market/), denied requests for injunctive relief from Kalshi, Crypto.com, and Robinhood.

All three platforms had asked the court to stop the Nevada Gaming Control Board from shutting down their sports-outcome contract offerings in the state. The court’s finding, according to [Insider Monkey’s report via Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/draftkings-flutter-jump-court-rules-194622553.html), was that these contracts function as sports bets rather than federally regulated swaps, putting them squarely within reach of state gambling law.

The classification question sits at the center of a wider fight. Prediction-market operators and the CFTC have argued that event contracts, including sports-outcome products, qualify as swaps subject to exclusive federal jurisdiction, which would bar states from regulating or banning them outright. Forty-four states have pushed back, arguing the products are sports betting dressed up in derivatives language, a dispute [tribal leaders have also raised with Congress](https://readwrite.com/tribal-leaders-warn-congress-prediction-markets-gambling/).

## Why the Timing Matters for Sportsbooks

Platforms like Kalshi have used the federal-swap designation to offer sports-outcome betting in states where traditional sportsbooks remain restricted or banned. That workaround has been a genuine competitive threat: DraftKings and Flutter have faced sustained valuation pressure over the past year, with analysts citing prediction markets’ rapid growth as a headwind, a trend also visible in [recent NFL betting-growth data](https://readwrite.com/nfl-betting-growth-stalls-prediction-markets/).

Shares of both companies jumped after the ruling. DraftKings gained as much as 10% and Flutter rose as much as 8% on August 28, per Insider Monkey’s figures. The move came despite institutional investors having already pulled back: DraftKings’ hedge fund ownership fell from 61 funds in the first quarter to 54 in the second, while Flutter’s dropped more sharply, from 57 to 37 over the same stretch.

A Bernstein research note cited by Intellectia.AI adds context to how unsettled the legal picture remains. The note points to a separate 2-1 Third Circuit ruling in *Flaherty v. KalshiEX* that treated sports event contracts as swaps, and says New Jersey has since asked the Supreme Court to review that decision – a filing that arrived five days after the Ninth Circuit’s contrary ruling. Bernstein’s analysts described the near-term outcome as more likely to be a regulatory patchwork than a clean, nationwide resolution.

## What Comes Next

Kalshi filed a petition for rehearing on September 9, and a Supreme Court review remains possible, both developments Insider Monkey flags as the key markers for whether this ruling holds. The court’s opinion itself, filed in *KalshiEX, LLC v. Assad*, is [available from the Ninth Circuit](https://cdn.ca9.uscourts.gov/datastore/opinions/2026/08/28/25-7516.pdf) for anyone tracking the underlying legal reasoning.

None of this settles the jurisdictional question nationally. The ruling applies to one circuit’s reasoning on one set of Nevada-related claims, and prediction-market operators have both the incentive and the legal resources to keep contesting it. Insider Monkey’s own read is that a single-day stock rally proves little on its own – a sustained institutional bid in DraftKings and Flutter, rather than a one-time price pop, would be the stronger signal that the competitive landscape has actually shifted.

The post [Nevada Gains Power to Regulate Sports Prediction Markets](https://readwrite.com/prediction-markets-nevada-gaming/) appeared first on [ReadWrite](https://readwrite.com).

entries.title: 问界致全体渠道伙伴的函曝光，授权经销商合作协议主体由华为终端转为赛力斯
entries.content:
IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，博主 @未来的学习笔记 刚刚曝光了问界致全体渠道伙伴的函。

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/f2fa9259-e9de-4259-8d31-c31129421d3a.png?x-bce-process=image/format,f_auto)

相关内容显示，问界已开启渠道变革，授权经销商合作协议主体由华为终端转为赛力斯。2026 年 9 月 16 日（含）起产生订单的综合服务费结算等事宜由赛力斯负责。赛力斯对用户的服务标准、品牌形象与定位、渠道授权模式和商务规则、运营标准与规范等均保持不变。

IT之家注意到，这封函还提到，**所有问界用户的既有权益不变，同时问界品牌会进一步专属专营**。

**相关阅读：**

* 《[华为、赛力斯合作模式“生变”，消息称此次为系统性、结构性调整](https://www.ithome.com/1/002/558.htm)》
* 《[消息称华为将采用轻资产方式与赛力斯合作，鸿蒙智行聚焦资源加速其他“四界”成功](https://www.ithome.com/1/002/475.htm)》

entries.title: 奥迪海外最便宜电动汽车 A2 e-tron 开放选配：基础版 3.82 万欧元，仅有手动调节织物座椅
entries.content:
IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，奥迪推进 A2 e-tron 的速度相当快：9 月 2 日首次亮相几天后便投入量产，并在德国开放配置。据外媒 motor1 今天（15 日）报道，新车起售价为 38,200 欧元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 29.7 万元人民币），已成为品牌旗下价格最低的电动汽车（在海外市场）。

德国官网选配环节所展示的是完全没有加任何选装的基础版。其采用**普通白色车漆、18 英寸轮圈，以及不带矩阵功能的 LED 大灯**。

![2027 Audi A2 E-Tron base model](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/e361d5d1-0ac6-4295-b3a6-22ab402654e9.jpg)

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/ac07355e-4770-4eae-b28a-95fd1cbebfb7.png)

内饰方面，该车采用**几乎全黑的配色搭配织物座椅**，标配双区自动空调和氛围灯、导航、电动调节及加热后视镜、无线手机充电。不过，前排座椅**仍采用手动调节**。

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/7775d3ee-c480-4c07-ad82-bac6a34c5f70.png)

动力方面，基础版 A2 e-tron 采用后置单电机，**最大功率 170 马力**，峰值扭矩 350N·m，0-100km/h 加速时间 8.8 秒，最高车速 160km/h，50kWh 锂离子电池可提供 421km WLTP 续航。

直流快充最高功率为 100kW，电量从 10% 充至 80% 需要 24 分钟；理想条件下，充电 10 分钟最多可以补充 115km WLTP 续航。

完全不加选装的基础版也是整个 A2 e-tron 车系中最轻的版本，整备质量为 1840kg。

38,200 欧元（现汇率约合 29.7 万元人民币）的起售价，也让入门版 A2 e-tron 比同平台的大众 ID.3 Neo 贵了 4000 多欧元。

IT之家查询获悉，在前述车型的基础上，将动力升级至 140kW 的基础售价为 4.19 万欧元（现汇率约合 32.5 万元人民币），升级至 170kW 则是 4.89 万欧元（现汇率约合 38 万元人民币），若选择 240kW 动力，价格也随之升至 5.12 万欧元（现汇率约合 39.8 万元人民币）。

此外，不同配置车型则根据“Tech”“Tech plus”“Tech pro”科技配置形成区隔，用户还可选装 S line 风格外观、冬季空调包等配置，内饰材质、方向盘样式等也支持自行选择。
entries.summary: 奥迪入门级电动车A2 e-tron在德国开放选配，起售价3.82万欧元。

entries.title: 苹果 iOS 27 系统小彩蛋：Liquid Glass 设置往下滑可召唤“狗牛”
entries.content:
IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，据多位用户投稿及IT之家验证，苹果在 iOS 27/iPadOS 27 操作系统藏了一个小彩蛋。

据悉，该彩蛋可以在以下位置找到：打开“设置”，点击“外观” → “Liquid Glass”，然后一直向下滑动“欢迎来到 Apple Park”示例图片，**直到搜索框出现“Moof!”文字并伴随几下震动**，**松开手指就能看到一只 Clarus**。

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/2efd56fd-6ca8-4893-a53f-c63662c1c097.jpg?x-bce-process=image/format,f_auto)

IT之家了解到，**Clarus 被许多用户称为“狗牛”（Dogcow）**。该形象最初源自 20 世纪 80-90 年代 Mac OS 系统的打印机设置界面，向用户直观展示打印纸张的方向。

该形象之所以称为 Dogcow，是因为它的分辨率过低，以至于无法分辨它是牛还是狗，这个符号超越了起源本身。如果你是 Mac 老用户，可能对此颇有感想。

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/9cf42d89-fd8e-4191-bc18-21f675d8ba95.gif)
entries.summary: iOS 27在Liquid Glass外观设置中加入经典Dogcow系统彩蛋。

entries.content:
The Genesis Mission is a historic national initiative led by DOE, which is building the world’s most powerful integrated science discovery platform. By uniting government, industry, academia, and philanthropy, it is accelerating breakthroughs in energy, scientific discovery, and national security through a new platform that combines AI, supercomputing, quantum systems, and advanced scientific instruments. [...] produce hyperlocal precipitation, runoff and flood-risk information for U.S. energy systems. Six Stony Brook researchers were among the initial Genesis Mission Phase II awards announced in July. [...] ## Project is the eighth Genesis Mission award associated with Stony Brook University
Brookhaven National Laboratory has been selected by the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) to lead a $14.2 million project to develop a next-generation grid foundation model (GridFM), an artificial intelligence (AI) system that can rapidly simulate scenarios for adding new loads to the electric grid.

entries.title: AI discovery exposes gap for luxury skin care brands - asianbusinessreview.com
entries.content: # AI discovery exposes gap for luxury skin care brands. \*\*Only 8% of skin care brands show measurable AI referrals\*\*. AI referrals are creating a visibility gap for luxury and premium skin care brands, with many brands that rank highly in global e-commerce performing poorly in AI-driven discovery, according to Euromonitor. Six of the 10 largest luxury and premium skin care brands by e-commerce rank sit outside the top 300 for AI referrals, the report said. An analysis of 36,917 skin care brands found that Helena Rubinstein ranked 15th globally for e-commerce but 1,531st for AI referrals. Estée Lauder and Lancôme are exceptions, ranking second and sixth, respectively, in global e-commerce and amongst the top 50 for AI referrals. Euromonitor classifies leading luxury and premium brands that perform strongly in global e-commerce but have weak or no measurable AI presence as “Luxury Revenue Orphans.” Geography also contributes to the gap.

entries.title: AI search will boost online marketplace stock, Oppenheimer says - CNBC
entries.content: Etsy is likely to get a boost from the growing use of artificial intelligence for virtual shopping, according to Oppenheimer. The investment firm upgraded the online marketplace to outperform from perform. It also set a $90 price target on shares, implying 21% upside from Monday's close. "[We are] upgrading ETSY to outperform (from perform) & establishing $90 target on AI search benefits, product improvements, and app engagement/conversion," analyst Jason Helfstein said Monday in a note to clients. Consumers are relying less on Google Search for online shopping, instead embracing AI tools for product discovery, according to a recent Oppenheimer survey. Adobe Analytics data also showed that nearly half of U.S. consumers used AI for online shopping in June . That trend should boost Etsy's sales and translate to upside for its stock, per Helfstein. The investment firm's poll also showed that consumers have noted an improvement in Etsy's product listings and descriptions, which should make product discovery easier and promote more sales on the platform.

entries.title: Chemistry textbooks have been getting this wrong for nearly 100 years - Science Daily
entries.content: : A foundational chemistry concept found in textbooks for almost 100 years may have been taught incorrectly. The team argues that updating this explanation could make organic chemistry easier to understand and provide a stronger foundation for future research and innovation. A chemistry concept taught to generations of students may need to be explained very differently, according to an international team of researchers who say a long-accepted textbook description does not match modern evidence. The issue centers on the inductive effect, a fundamental idea in structural organic chemistry used to describe how atoms influence the distribution of electrons within molecules. A new paper in the \*Journal of Chemical Education\* now expands on those findings and examines what they could mean for the way one of chemistry's foundational concepts is taught. "The inductive effect is a foundational concept in chemical bonding, because it is used to explain how electrons are distributed between atoms in molecules," explains Dr. Mark Elliott, lead author of the study from Cardiff University's School of Chemistry.

entries.title: Apple Watch Series 12 Siri Recap listens all day, but Apple can't access the audio
entries.content:
Your Apple Watch Series 12 will continuously listen to your conversations, but Apple claims it's locked out of the audio. Here's how the new hardware isolation works.  
  

![Smartwatch with dark screen showing notifications beside smartphone displaying a white news-style app with multiple article cards and colorful thumbnails on a light gray background](https://media.appleinsider.com/gallery/68976-145386-0B3ADA81-CB5E-484E-86D7-25C5C6A4995D-xl.jpg)Apple Watch Series 12 with Apple Intelligence

  
The new Audio Intelligence features include [Siri Recap](https://appleinsider.com/articles/26/09/09/siri-on-apple-watch-can-remember-useful-parts-of-your-day-without-retaining-everything), which summarizes conversations, and Live Rewind, which retrieves the preceding 15 seconds as text. Automatic Shazam recognition and alerts for sounds such as alarms, sirens, and doorbells use the same protected system.  
  
Because [Siri](https://appleinsider.com/inside/siri "Siri") Recap operates without warning other speakers, the features raise questions about what an Apple Watch hears, where the audio goes, and whether anyone could retrieve it. Apple's September [privacy paper](https://www.apple.com/privacy/docs/Audio_Intelligence_Privacy_Overview_Sep_2026.pdf) describes an S11 component called the Secure Exclave as the answer.  
  
Microphone audio can exist temporarily inside that protected hardware without becoming a playable or retrievable recording, according to Apple. Siri Recap can still transfer encrypted audio from the Apple Watch to a paired [iPhone](https://appleinsider.com/inside/iphone "iPhone") before turning it into text.

entries.title: This Atlantic hurricane season is about to do something that hasn't happened in 175 years
entries.content:
Last week, the Atlantic hurricane season blew through its traditional peak—which comes around September 10—with nary a tropical wave in sight, let alone a storm or hurricane.

This is remarkable. Usually this is the time of year when sea surface temperatures reach their warmest in the tropics, and with a favorable atmosphere it should be smooth skating for tropical systems. But this year, the main region where most tropical systems develop is choked with Saharan dust and wind shear.

No one is complaining. Landfalling hurricanes are incredibly destructive for coastal areas and have the potential for considerable inland rainfall. Even storms at sea, in the Gulf of Mexico, can send energy prices skyrocketing—the last thing needed this year.

entries.title: ‘Widow’s Bay’ sweeps as Apple TV cleans up on Emmy night
entries.content:
[Macworld](https://www.macworld.com)

Apple TV continued its triumphant awards season on Monday night, with the offbeat comedy-horror *Widow’s Bay* reaching a total of 14 Emmy wins for the year. *Pluribus* and *Slow Horses* also scored wins this week, adding to Emmy successes for other Apple TV properties such as *Mr. Scorsese*, *Palm Royale*, and *Margo’s Got Money Troubles* earlier in the month.

The Emmys are split into multiple ceremonies. The first section of the 2026 awards, Creative Arts, took place on September 5-6. *Widow’s Bay* was the most successful show across the two nights with eight wins (from 12 nominations) and [added six more](https://www.televisionacademy.com/features/news/awards-news/78th-emmys-winners-recap) (from seven nominations) during the major Primetime awards this week, again making it the most successful entrant. Here are the show’s 14 wins:

### Creative Arts awards

* Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series (Betty Gilpin as Sarah Westcott Warren)
* Outstanding Production Design for a Narrative Program
* Outstanding Casting for a Comedy Series
* Outstanding Cinematography for a Series
* Outstanding Music Composition for a Series
* Outstanding Music Supervision
* Outstanding Sound Editing for a Comedy or Drama Series and Animation
* Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series and Animation

### Primetime (or major) awards

* Outstanding Comedy Series
* Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series (Matthew Rhys as Tom Loftis)
* Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series (Stephen Root as Wyck Crawford)
* Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series (Kate O’Flynn as Patricia Moyer)
* Outstanding Directing for a Comedy Series
* Outstanding Writing for a Comedy Series

Everybody else was left in the dirt by *Widow’s Bay*‘s 14 wins. Its closest rivals were (the superb) *DTF St. Louis*, *The Traitors*, and the Super Bowl halftime show, which each scored seven; but none of these managed more than a single major award. Unlike Apple’s show, which collected six of these most prestigious wins.

Those 14 wins also beat any previous Apple TV entrant; *The Studio* previously held Cupertino’s record with 13 in 2025. And with a total of 29 Emmy wins altogether (if you include the company’s Outstanding Commercial award, which isn’t credited to its streaming arm), Apple as a whole had its most successful year to date, surpassing the 22 it managed last year thanks to the success of *The Studio* and *Severance*. Before then, the company never managed more than 10 wins in a single year.

It was also the first Emmy night for new CEO John Ternus, who [proudly showed off his iPhone Duo](https://x.com/DEADLINE/status/2099645816361332775?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E2099645816361332775%7Ctwgr%5E0f3d969788422329ccb3ebf2957715cc25ad8250%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2F9to5mac.com%2F2026%2F09%2F14%2Fnew-apple-ceo-john-ternus-attending-emmy-awards-and-sporting-iphone-duo%2F) on the red carpet.

entries.title: Sarah Michelle Gellar lands jab at cancelled Buffy reboot during Emmys
entries.content:
![Sarah Michelle Gellar and David Boreanaz present the Outstanding Lead Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie award onstage during the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards.](https://helios-i.mashable.com/imagery/videos/02qeTYbSaTKFpvbZSzgrbPw/hero-image.jpg)

Sarah Michelle Gellar landed a perfect smack to the cancellation of the *Buffy the Vampire Slayer* reboot on the [Emmys](https://mashable.com/category/emmys) stage.

Joined by her *Buffy* co-star David Boreaneaz to present Outstanding Lead Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie at the [78th Primetime Emmy Awards](https://mashable.com/entertainment/emmys-2026-winners-list), the star took one moment to drive a stake through the heart of the unrealised series.

"You know, Sarah, I always through that Buffy and Angel would end up together,” said Boreaneaz.

"Well, I guess we won't find out," responded Gellar.

Gellar, who played vampire slayer Buffy Summers for seven seasons of the series from 1997 to 2003, had been [working with director Chloé Zhao](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/buffy-reboot-dead-hulu-sarah-michelle-gellar-chloe-zhao-1236692284/) on a reboot, with Hulu and Searchlight Television on board. In March 2026, Gellar told [*People*](https://people.com/sarah-michelle-gellar-reveals-what-killed-buffy-reboot-nobody-exclusive-11927330) she got a call at SXSW and was told the series wasn't happening after all: "I was just about to take the stage in front of all the fans. Hulu had decided not to move forward with the *Buffy* revival. Let me tell you, nobody saw this coming."

For *Buffy* fans, the ceremony had a more heartbreaking moment, with [the Emmys' "In Memoriam" segment](https://mashable.com/entertainment/emmys-in-memoriam-2026) paying tribute to late actor Anthony Head, who played debonair librarian and Watcher Rupert Giles in the series.

For [everything that happened at the 2026 Emmys](https://mashable.com/entertainment/emmys-2026-winners-list), we've got you covered.

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-09-15.

This release fixes a regression in 0.12.14 that lead to rejecting valid installation commands such as using  
`uv pip install --system` in `python:*` docker images or when using `uv pip install --target .`. ([#21699](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21699))

### Performance

* Speed up cold-cache resolution and HTTP cache revalidation by batching cache writes ([#21675](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21675))

### Bug fixes

* Revert "Reject symlinked wheel installation destinations" ([#21699](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21699))

## Install uv 0.12.15

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.12.15/uv-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.12.15/uv-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

entries.title: Shared Hosting at Risk: LiteSpeed Enterprise Bug Can Grant Root from a Single Tenant
entries.content:
## Critical LiteSpeed Enterprise flaw lets one shared hosting account gain root, bypassing CageFS; patch now to 6.3.7 via forced update.

cPanel warned that a critical flaw in LiteSpeed Enterprise can let a low‑privilege website user break out of their account and gain root on the whole server. On a box where dozens or hundreds of customers live side by side, that’s not a theoretical risk. It’s a full cross‑tenant compromise. Attackers could then access or modify other websites and the server itself.

*“We have received notice that a critical privilege-escalation vulnerability has been identified in LiteSpeed Web Server Enterprise. On shared-hosting servers, a malicious low-privilege website user could potentially gain root-level access to the server. This could allow an attacker to access or alter other hosted websites and the server itself.” [reads the advisory](https://support.cpanel.net/hc/en-us/articles/43483286674583-Security-LiteSpeed-Enterprise-security-advisory-September-14-2026).*

*“This issue can bypass expected account isolation controls, including CageFS, allowing a malicious website user to potentially escape its restricted environment and gain root-level access to the server.”*

The flaw affects versions before 6.3.7 and can bypass the isolation that keeps hosting accounts apart, including CageFS. CageFS is the CloudLinux layer that gives each account a restricted view of the filesystem so it can’t peek at other users or server configs.

If this flaw truly defeats that boundary, then one bad tenant can read or change other sites and take control of the machine.

Neither cPanel nor LiteSpeed disclosed technical details about the vulnerability. LiteSpeed’s September 11 announcement for 6.3.7 just mentions “Security improvements, bug fixes, and more!” and the changelog lists three security changes without calling out a privilege‑escalation issue.

There’s no CVE or severity rating yet, and it’s unclear whether attackers are already exploiting the flaw.

Both cPanel and LiteSpeed urge admins to run this command to update their installs:

`/usr/local/lsws/admin/misc/lsup.sh -f -v 6.3.7`

LiteSpeed warns that version 6.3.7 may take some time to reach the stable auto-update channel. As of September 15, the download page still listed 6.3.6 as the latest stable version. Forcing 6.3.7 means temporarily leaving the stable update channel, which can be restored later.

There’s no workaround for systems you can’t patch immediately. The advisory only covers the Enterprise edition; OpenLiteSpeed, the open‑source variant, had no matching update as of September 15.

LiteSpeed-related flaws have now been linked to three root-level escapes on cPanel shared-hosting servers since May.

This year, LiteSpeed fixed two flaws in its cPanel plugin, [CVE-2026-48172](https://securityaffairs.com/192795/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-litespeed-cpanel-plugin-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) and [CVE-2026-54420](https://securityaffairs.com/193684/security/u-s-cisa-adds-cisco-catalyst-and-litespeed-cpanel-plugin-flaws-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html), which were being actively exploited in the wild. CISA added both issues to is Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

entries.title: 飞连，让豆包工作更安全办公
entries.content:
原创 飞连 2026-09-15 17:00 北京

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=80ab9081&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2FFGB4hYw9Fee6Kw8zUXW1QMawCXEV6g36fBbB9jISBsAq8Ooh8KHIopqsicqsmUj8Xf5PDTdE8dtK47maq8QAh8U0RNjKxHQtH0zZVHTUDouE%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

以豆包工作为代表的新一代办公 Agent，能够理解工作目标，自主处理资料、分析信息、生成内容，并借助工具和 Skill 协助完成复杂任务。员工可以将一项具体工作交给 AI，豆包工作也由此成为企业提升办公效率的重要生产力工具。

豆包工作已具备完善的原生安全能力，但在终端数据外发、Agent 运行及企业 AI 治理等场景，新的安全问题也随之出现：豆包工作处理和产生的数据如何保护？Agent 执行任务时如何控制风险？企业统一使用豆包工作后，又该如何管理员工使用的其他 AI 工具？

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=a7e83029&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FFGB4hYw9Fee2Ehqhia6N4tjickfjppcPmk5qRKV7jibicEF0RseKgyyCDIkWe1mzeX9V444y4MmF1cJ1KwJQLLh718ldBdarZ70Z7qtyhuQLQlU%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

围绕这些场景，飞连将安全能力融入豆包工作的使用过程，从**工作成果保护、Agent 运行安全，到整体 AI 办公治理**，为企业使用 AI 提供安全保障。

**保护敏感数据——豆包工作产出的成果，如何安全流转？**

豆包工作进入企业办公后，会接触内部文档、业务资料、经营数据等信息，并基于这些内容生成报告、文档等工作成果。这些 AI 参与生成的内容，也可能包含企业敏感信息。

例如，员工将企业资料交给豆包工作分析，AI 完成任务后生成报告。员工将报告下载到本地，再通过邮件、网盘等渠道向外发送，就可能形成新的数据泄露路径。

飞连将数据安全能力延伸至 AI 工作成果，结合数据来源和敏感数据识别，对豆包工作处理、生成的文件和内容进行保护，并根据企业策略控制敏感数据的流转，降低文件下载、本地生成等场景带来的泄露风险。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=c671223b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FFGB4hYw9Fee8F227ibN4DNDpeicJLnqe32icWGS6scnibfXpb0H2HU8qXPQTWbqYUyXAyt6wNqMF9kGbyL5tv5tvIxYQlaG8YUib2YUVP4m1xkbc%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=41971100&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FFGB4hYw9FecgNZlCVHiabibPJl6db35GrPwwrQBia7OPDrAP3Rn4CsAJN02QfS9T2HxP5BJLvQR2XHau3T9a03rTfLDqRkqZ8ib5NRe126rzal4%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

左右滑动查看更多精彩内容

**Agent 运行保护——让豆包工作安全地“干活”**

员工在使用豆包工作时，可能会根据需要加载不同的 Skill。如果 Skill 中包含恶意指令，就可能诱导 Agent 执行非预期操作，影响办公终端安全。

飞连会对 Skill 的下载进行检测，阻断恶意 Skill 进入办公环境；对于终端中已经存在的本地 Skill 文件，也可以持续扫描，发现风险后及时告警并隔离。

在更广泛的 AI 使用管理上，企业可以按照自身策略，对高风险 Agent、AI 工具和 AI 网站设置访问限制。比如，企业统一推广豆包工作后，可以限制员工使用其他高风险 Agent，控制个人版 AI 的使用范围。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=2cbf4e5d&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FFGB4hYw9Fec7n4Jwt3EqtJ8DVUv3J5a9kesMmJAcONEtMOh6f48oxqW0YXeZfAcwdGuicDIEcLBric3THUz3icYxTJUrUEFeJPlJpUpfJJv1Bo%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**覆盖桌面 Agent ——从豆包工作，延伸到整个 AI 办公**

随着技术的快速发展，办公环境中的 AI 也会越来越多。员工可能自行安装其他 AI Agent，或通过浏览器访问第三方 AI 网站，一些 Agent 还会调用大模型、MCP、CLI 等外部能力。这些游离于企业管理之外的“影子 AI”，同样可能接触企业数据、执行办公任务，带来不可见的安全风险。

飞连可以从终端、网络和应用行为中持续发现 AI 资产，帮助企业了解：终端上有哪些 AI 工具？员工访问了哪些 AI 网站？哪些 Agent 正在调用大模型、MCP、CLI？Agent 是否执行了高风险任务？

基于这些可视化信息，企业可以进一步针对不同 AI 应用和使用场景制定访问控制、终端防护和数据安全策略，将安全能力覆盖到豆包工作之外的 AI 办公场景。

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=be95461e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_png%2FFGB4hYw9FecibVbO2TqYJvLOlPnmMlLAicp4ibBI9XKJRpSUp8RVtwH7MOtJyIBY1Ric8h0NwuAu7ib1tTEUfrGmTCzUVticfoqvq8iaaibkI9LtmY4%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)

**让 AI 在安全边界内创造价值**

豆包工作正在把 AI 带入更多真实的企业工作场景。当 AI 开始处理企业数据、执行工作任务、生成业务成果，传统围绕“人”和“终端”建立的办公安全边界，也需要覆盖 AI 参与工作的全过程。

围绕豆包工作的企业办公场景，飞连从工作成果的数据保护，到 Agent 的安全运行，再延伸至企业整体 AI 办公环境，为 AI 进入企业提供与生产力相匹配的安全保障。

飞连让企业放心把工作交给 AI，也让 AI 在清晰、可控的安全边界内创造价值。

主要帮大家解决 AI 时代两大主流文件在手机上无法预览的问题。

entries.title: 启境汽车回应 GX7 是否会推纯电版：请留意官方信息，敬请期待
entries.content:
IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，启境汽车今天（15 日）晚间发布第 12 期答网友问，回应“启境 GX7 是否会推出纯电版”称，启境 GX7 目前推出增程动力版本，**后续如有产品新动态，将通过启境汽车官方渠道第一时间发布，请留意官方信息，敬请期待**。

产品规划上，新车预计 **2026 年 9 月底正式上市**，届时将同步开启交付。

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/f2b5a10c-c03d-48cf-b0d5-9a5b58d8e348.png)

终身质保权益方面，启境 GX7 的整车和核心零部件终身质保权益，除雨刮片、轮胎、空调滤芯、制动片等易损耗零部件外，三电系统（IT之家注：动力电池总成、驱动电机总成、电机控制器总成）、**增程器、空气悬架、智慧投影大灯、减振器**等高价值部件均在终身质保范围内。

此外，启境 GX7 的整车和核心零部件终身质保权益不对车辆的里程进行限制。除了不限制行驶里程外，对维修次数、维修金额、保障时长也没有限制。首任非营运车主，只要车辆不过户，保持非营运性质，“持有车辆多久，就能保障多久。”

启境 GX7 车身尺寸为长 5099 mm、宽 2006 mm、高 1750 mm，轴距 3070 mm；有茶卡银、梅里白、贝加尔蓝、西湖烟紫、普罗旺斯紫、帕米尔黑六款车色可选。

启境 GX7 搭载**华为七大汽车智能化解决方案**：包含华为乾崑智驾、鸿蒙座舱、华为乾崑赤兔平台、华为乾崑车载光、华为乾崑车云、华为鲸鳍通信、华为智擎电驱。

启境 GX7 首批搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5，同级唯一 4 颗激光雷达，搭载 38 个高性能传感器（前向 14 个、后向 12 个、侧向 12 个）；也是鸿蒙座舱 6 首批搭载车型。

启境 GX7 全系标配宁德时代电池，提供 52kWh 和 67kWh 两种版本，CLTC 纯电续航里程 325-385km，CLTC 综合续航里程 1500-1580km。

新车定位中大型阔五座 SUV，**预售价 24.99-31.19 万元**。

* 增程 Ultra 版：预售价 24.99 万元
* 增程 Ultra 双电机版：预售价 26.99 万元
* 增程 Ultra 三电机版：预售价 31.19 万元

entries.title: 博通 CEO 陈福阳回应 AI 放缓担忧：算力需求仍强劲，长期收入目标不变
entries.content:
IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，博通（Broadcom）首席执行官陈福阳（Hock Tan）于当地时间周一回应了市场担忧。针对前沿 AI 模型开发节奏有可能放缓会对这家芯片厂商业务造成冲击的疑问，他在接受 CNBC 采访时表态，公司仍维持长期收入目标不变。

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/4188d302-265b-431d-b5ab-c9331227392f.png?x-bce-process=image/format,f_auto)

就在此前的周末，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫代伊（Dario Amodei）发表了一篇文章，主张适度放缓大模型的研发速度，这件事令投资者人心惶惶。阿莫代伊的观点得到了 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）以及埃隆 · 马斯克的认同。受此影响，周一交易日当中，AI 基础设施板块的投资者开始重新评估算力需求前景。

Anthropic 本就是博通定制芯片业务最重要的客户之一，博通股价因此下跌 4.8%；半导体宽基 ETF 安硕半导体 ETF（iShares Semiconductor ETF）跌幅达到 5.6%；其他数据中心硬件厂商的股票同样遭遇重挫。

CNBC 节目《疯狂金钱（Mad Money）》主持人吉姆 · 克莱默向陈福阳提问：这场关于 AI 放缓的讨论，是否会促使博通重新审视 2027 财年与 2028 财年 AI 半导体业务业绩预期。“不会，丝毫不会。”陈福阳给出答复。“无论是用于前沿 AI 模型训练，还是已经落地的 AI 产品所需要的推理算力，我们看到算力基础设施的需求依旧十分旺盛，而且我相信这种需求具备很强的持续性。”

在 9 月 2 日举行的博通 2026 财年第三季度财报电话会议上，陈福阳此前已经作出预测：2027 财年 AI 半导体业务营收将达到 1,150 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 7,733.98 亿元人民币）；到 2028 财年该数字再度翻番至 2,300 亿美元（现汇率约合 1.55 万亿元人民币）。2028 年这份超出市场预期的业绩指引，曾经是这份财报当中的一大亮点。博通的 AI 业务既包含 AI 定制加速芯片，也包括 AI 系统内部使用的网络芯片。

陈福阳同时提到，Anthropic 有望在 2027 年成长为博通最大的定制芯片客户，并且在 2028 年继续保持这一地位。这也解释了为何博通的投资者会对阿莫代伊的言论反应如此敏感。在此之前，谷歌一直是博通最大的定制业务客户，双方曾合作共同设计谷歌 TPU 张量处理器。

陈福阳尤其看好推理业务的需求，也就是大模型完成训练之后、面向日常实际调用阶段产生的算力。

“训练侧的情况我不好判断。但当大家要把 AI 做成产品、开展推理部署的时候，我看到这块需求依旧会极其强劲。”陈福阳如是说。

阿莫代伊周末发布的文章进一步激化了一场行业争论：AI 行业研发强力大模型的脚步是否行进得过快。阿莫代伊提出了一套三步方案，希望在不“牺牲商业优势以及美国在 AI 领域领先地位”的前提下，放缓模型开发节奏。

陈福阳表示，他认同阿莫代伊的看法，认为 AI 的确需要设立一定约束；不过他本人并不对这项技术的发展前景感到恐慌。

“和所有工具一样，我们的确需要建立治理机制与安全防护，规范这项工具的使用方式。”陈福阳说道。

但他同时提出自己的观点：“AI 并不是活物，它不会自己不受控制地肆意作乱。”

陈福阳转而着重强调 AI 提升生产力的巨大潜力：“生成式 AI、前沿大模型的研发…… 将会创造巨大价值。”他将 AI 浪潮类比始于 18 世纪英国的工业革命，“说到底它只是一种工具，终将推动整个社会、全人类迈向更高的生活水平。”

entries.title: 因 iOS 18 导致部分 iPhone 15 屏幕绿线，苹果遭印度消费者保护机构调查
entries.content:
IT之家 9 月 15 日消息，据外媒 Appleinsider 今天报道，印度中央消费者保护局（CCPA）已对苹果公司发起调查，重点审查其软件保修政策，并指控苹果对消费者收取过高维修费用。

![](https://img.ithome.com/newsuploadfiles/2026/9/01a464d2-3a1e-419e-965b-2a1e5af06bc8.jpg?x-bce-process=image/format,f_auto)

据报道，本次调查起因源自 2024 年的 iOS 18 系统。**当时部分 iPhone 15 用户升级系统后**，**屏幕出现绿色 / 粉色或白色线条**。这些消费者找到苹果售后时，却被要求支付 27,900 卢比（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,959 元人民币）维修显示屏。

印度消费者保护机构已告知苹果，称正在详细调查此次事件。

苹果对此回应称，公司不提供软件保修符合全球标准，且 iOS 18 不存在系统性问题。该公司还认为，印度消费者保护机构的主张仅基于 75 起投诉发起，并不能代表广大消费者。

此外苹果表示，用户使用 iOS 软件前都会看到条款，写明“软件不提供任何形式保证，如果软件出现问题，用户需自行承担维修费用，苹果有限保修仅包含硬件。”

entries.title: Latent Labs：Alphafold 3 发布两年，AI 药物设计进展到了哪一步？
entries.content:
原创 Daniel、Cage 2026-09-15 18:00 北京

![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=fbb0f356&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_jpg%2FQUs3kaltEh09gvWcgehQyH1w7VAAkgU98icBaA5HruiaWsgFVLmGiaoONR5Ng7uIVMZrEfFIib3ibw0FW5TWwSD6q3cqjIaAOz5EKuOOI0r4MRFE%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg)

Alphafold 原班人马打造的分子设计模型与 Agent

[![](https://wechat2rss.bestblogs.dev/img-proxy/?k=4ea308ce&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fmmbiz_png%2FQUs3kaltEh1UlDTqakV074ibY4lkYldX5gIkszbhwrWCUKdQTGykI9E453pQld7p2BibnPLwBb2tELTEy7UNvfsial1aFvTUVbrk8GP26Usa00%2F640%3Fwx_fmt%3Dpng%26from%3Dappmsg)](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/mp/appmsgalbum?__biz=Mzg2OTY0MDk0NQ==&action=getalbum&album_id=4157672299245862924&scene=21#wechat_redirect)

作者：Daniel

编辑：Cage　⁠

我们认为，AI for Science 是 AI 继 Coding 之后的下一个重点方向。而药物发现又是其中最有前景的赛道。一方面，药物试验拥有完整反馈闭环且高度可验证，是实现 RSI 的理想场景。另一方面，AI 可以解放实验人员的产能，使得大量休眠靶点有重新开发的机会。**我们有十足的理由相信，下一个药物大发现时代很可能便是由 AI 推动的。**

　⁠

AlphaFold 让我们看到了 AI 理解蛋白质结构的能力，而 **AI 的下一个战场，是设计传统方法做不到的分子。**这是一个激烈竞争的领域，除了从 Google Deepmind 中诞生的 Isomophic 之外，Chai Discovery、Boltz、 Latent Labs 也分别发布他们的预测模型与药物模态区别化下注。蛋白质从头设计也逐渐走近药物研发的实际应用。

　⁠

Latent Labs 是观察这一变化的重要样本：创始人 Simon Kohl 曾参与 AlphaFold 2 的核心研发，押注了环肽这一新兴模态类型并选择自建湿实验室。2025 年 2 月，公司以累计 $5,000 万融资走出隐身状态，吸引了包括 Jeff Dean、Aidan Gomez 的天使投资。同年 7 月，发布了面向小蛋白与环肽的生成模型 Latent-X。并在 12 月用 Latent-X2 进一步覆盖纳米抗体和抗体片段，并关注表达、稳定性及免疫原性等成药相关性质；2026 年 3 月发布的 Latent-Y 则是在这些模型之上构建的科研 Agent。

　⁠

不可否认的是，目前各家正在测试的蛋白质还没到可以成药的阶段。他们只是完成了流程的第一步：证明自己能够作为结合物发挥作用。如果我们把药物的研发比作登山，人类过去已经攀登过无数山峰，且资本市场也给予了创新者极其丰厚的回报。从 PD-1 到 CAR-T，再到近期大火的 GLP-1 都是很好的证明。但攀登的道路极其困难，往往需要数年+数十亿美元作为成本。**AI 药物发现的目标，是把一条条狭窄的山路变成高速公路，且让人们向更高更危险的山峰发起冲击。**

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ⁠ | / | ⁠ |

01.

## Key thesis:

　⁠

•蛋白质生成模型的出现颠覆传统制药流程，很可能带来一个药物大发现时代

　⁠

传统药物发现是在庞大的真实分子库中寻找少数有效候选，生成模型则可以根据需求设计自然界不存在的分子。变化不仅是筛选效率提高，更是能够探索过去难以触及的分子空间。长期价值不只是“更便宜地做药”，而是让同样的研发资源能够探索更多项目，未来的药物研发可能打破“反摩尔定律”，实现质和量的大幅跃升。

　⁠

•结合物发现环节高度可验证，是实现 RSI 的理想场景，Latent 湿实验室自建为竞争优势

　⁠

在药物发现里面，设计结合物环境是最为可控，最容易产生 loop 的。结合本质上就是两个分子表面的形状互补 + 化学互补，有明确的物理规律，终点明确且反馈回路快。随着计算生成成本下降，稀缺资源将逐渐从候选分子转向高质量的实验反馈。Latent 逐步将实验能力放于内部，有机会更紧密地连接模型研发与实验判断。

　⁠

•生物医药领域长坡厚雪，每种模态都会诞生领先大玩家， Latent 模态选择上有差异

　⁠

行业内短期的催化是专利断崖正在发生，各大药企开始重视药物发现相关技术。不同模态面对的设计约束和开发难点不同，单一模型难以在所有任务上保持优势，制药公司也倾向与多家公司合作。大环肽是 Latent 最值得关注的切入口。它有机会覆盖传统小分子难以处理的结合界面，同时在部分场景中提供不同于抗体的药物属性。它也是目前的热门赛道，已有多款新药受到市场青睐。

　⁠

•以 AlphaFold 成员为班底打造的明星团队

　⁠

创始人 Simon Kohl 参与开发 AlphaFold 2，随后发起并共同领导 DeepMind 的蛋白质设计团队；创始技术成员 Alex Bridgland 曾参与 AlphaFold 1、2、3，覆盖模型开发、评估与数据工程。团队中多数成员拥有丰厚药物模型研发经验，与专注实验平台与内部湿实验室的科学家形成互补。团队还有前默克集团 CEO 作为顾问参与，为团队打进大型制药公司奠定基础。
